title: Facts about two people that must not be mixed up
description: Mum and Dad each have tablets and an appointment. Dad's dose and appointment change. An answer about one person must never carry the other's details.

notes.text: Mum takes 1 x Tablet B each morning.
Dad takes 1 x Tablet C each evening.
Dad's clinic appointment is Friday 13 March.
Mum's podiatry appointment is Monday 9 March.
Mum's eye test went well. No change to her glasses.
Dad's clinic has moved his appointment to Friday 20 March.
The clinic doctor raised Dad's dose: he now takes 3 x Tablet C each evening.
Mum wants a lift to the podiatrist; Dad will drive.
Picked up both prescriptions in one trip.
Refilled the weekly pill box for both of them.

questions.ask: What does Mum take each morning?
questions.why: Her tablet never changed; Dad's tablet must not replace it.

questions.ask: How much Tablet C does Dad take?

questions.why: Mum's date is unchanged; Dad's date from an earlier note must not appear as hers.

questions.ask: What does each of them take?
questions.why: Both people, each with their own current dose.
Only Mum's eye test is in the notes.
